en: The image depicts a black-and-white historical photograph of a religious procession on a cobblestone street. The main focus is a group of people carrying a large reliquary shrine, surrounded by clergy and men in formal attire. The street is lined with spectators, many wearing early 20th-century European clothing and hats. Banners and religious icons are being carried, and the buildings in the background have distinctly European architectural features.
